questions.text: Tell us about a time you designed test cases for a feature. How did you decide what to test first?
questions.demoAnswer: In my Quality Assurance & Control project, our team built a checkout form for a small online shop, and I was in charge of testing it. I listed every field first, then used boundary value analysis on the quantity and postcode fields. That gave me 14 test cases. I started with the quantity field because a wrong value there changes the price. I also ran an integration test to check the quantity field rejects 0 and 100.
